title: Suntory Wellness says a maximum of 94万7,667 (最大94万7,667件) items of Comado app customer information leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
date_note: Date of Suntory Wellness's announcement as stated by Cybersecurity.com (published 24 November); the unauthorised access to KARTE is stated as 13 November.
geo_basis: country named in the source; the article names no city, pin at Tokyo
summary: Cybersecurity.com reports that Suntory Wellness announced on 19 November that a maximum of 94万7,667 (最大94万7,667件) items of information from its Comado health app were leaked. The article says a third party gained unauthorised access to KARTE, the PLAID service Comado uses, on 13 November. The leaked items are nickname, gender, age, purchased product names, an app management ID and payment-method category.
plain: Suntory Wellness says information from its Comado health app, a maximum of 94万7,667 (最大94万7,667件) items, leaked after a third party accessed a PLAID service the app uses. Nicknames, ages and purchased product names are among the items.
exec: A supplier's breach exposed a maximum of 94万7,667 (最大94万7,667件) items of Comado app customer information, including purchased product names, the article reports.
impact: A maximum of 94万7,667 (最大94万7,667件) items of Comado app information.

evidence.quote: サントリーウエルネスは11月19日、健康アプリ「Comado」のニックネームや年齢、購入商品名など最大94万7,667件の情報漏えいを公表したと発表した。

validation.note: Only Cybersecurity.com (Japan) was read, relaying the company's announcement; Suntory Wellness's own page did not load (socket hang up).
